name: gather
description: GATHER: friend-group scheduling, polls, Idea Bank, expenses, and an AI assistant

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.reset: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('server/data',{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('Local database deleted. It is re-seeded on next start.')"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm start --prefix server
